quests.passage: Every pen and notebook on her desk had its own spot, and she kept it that way — always neat, never a paper out of place.
quests.question: tidy and in good order
quests.hint: Think about how the pens and notebooks are arranged.
quests.explanation: 'Neat' describes things kept clean and in order, with everything where it belongs. Her desk stays organized because nothing is left out of place.
quests.wordInContext: He folded his clothes into neat piles before packing his suitcase.

quests.passage: While the rest of the class tried each step of the puzzle one by one, the clever student noticed a shortcut that skipped half the work.
quests.question: quick at learning or understanding; smart
quests.hint: Compare what this student did with what the rest of the class did.
quests.explanation: 'Clever' describes someone who thinks quickly and finds smart solutions. Spotting a shortcut others missed shows real cleverness.
quests.wordInContext: It was a clever move to save the receipt in case the jacket needed to be returned.

quests.passage: Managers gave Mia the important tasks because she was reliable — she finished everything on time, without anyone needing to check on her.
quests.question: able to be trusted to do what is expected
quests.hint: Notice why the managers trust Mia specifically.
quests.explanation: 'Reliable' describes someone or something you can depend on. Mia earns this trust by consistently finishing her work on time.
quests.wordInContext: The old truck wasn't fast, but it was reliable, starting every morning without fail.

quests.passage: From the ship's deck, the island looked distant, just a gray shape sitting on the edge of the horizon.
quests.question: far away in space
quests.hint: Think about how close or far the island appears from the ship.
quests.explanation: 'Distant' means far away. The island appearing as only a small shape on the horizon shows how far off it is.
quests.wordInContext: She could still remember her grandfather's voice, even from those distant childhood summers.

quests.passage: The children's laughter carried all the way to the garden, loud enough that their grandmother heard every giggle from her chair outside.
quests.question: producing a lot of sound; not quiet
quests.hint: Notice how far the sound traveled and who could hear it.
quests.explanation: 'Loud' describes sound that is strong and easy to hear, even at a distance. The grandmother hearing it from the garden proves how loud it was.
quests.wordInContext: The neighbors complained about the loud music coming from the party next door.

quests.passage: With prices kept affordable, most families in the neighborhood managed to buy their children new shoes before school started.
quests.question: priced at a level that people can reasonably pay
quests.hint: Think about why so many families were able to make this purchase.
quests.explanation: 'Affordable' means priced within reach for most people. Families buying new shoes without difficulty shows the prices were reasonable.
quests.wordInContext: Finding an affordable apartment near the city center took them almost two months.

quests.passage: Everyone at the table reached for a second slice of the homemade pizza, calling it the most tasty thing they'd eaten all week.
quests.question: having a pleasant, strong flavor
quests.hint: Notice how people reacted to the pizza and what they said about it.
quests.explanation: 'Tasty' describes food with a good, satisfying flavor. Guests wanting seconds and praising the pizza shows how good it tasted.
quests.wordInContext: The street vendor's noodles were cheap but genuinely tasty.

quests.passage: Paying bills through the banking app is convenient, since it takes only a few taps instead of a trip to the bank.
quests.question: easy to do without wasting time or effort
quests.hint: Compare the two ways of paying bills mentioned in the passage.
quests.explanation: 'Convenient' describes something that saves time and effort. Paying with a few taps is far easier than traveling somewhere in person.
quests.wordInContext: Living near the train station is convenient for her daily commute.

quests.passage: By the time the marathon ended, the runners were exhausted, their legs shaking as they stumbled toward the finish line.
quests.question: extremely tired, with no energy left
quests.hint: Think about the physical state of the runners after twenty-six miles.
quests.explanation: 'Exhausted' describes being completely worn out, more tired than usual. The shaking legs and struggle to stand show total exhaustion.
quests.wordInContext: After moving furniture all day, he was too exhausted to cook dinner.

quests.passage: The magician kept the show so entertaining that the children begged their parents to stay for one more trick.
quests.question: enjoyable to watch; holding people's attention
quests.hint: Notice how the children responded when the show was about to end.
quests.explanation: 'Entertaining' describes something that holds people's interest and gives them enjoyment. The children not wanting it to end shows how much fun it was.
quests.wordInContext: Her stories about traveling alone through Vietnam were always entertaining at dinner parties.

quests.passage: David sank into the new sofa after work and, within minutes, fell asleep — it was that comfortable.
quests.question: giving a pleasant feeling of physical ease; not causing discomfort
quests.hint: Think about how quickly David fell asleep on this piece of furniture.
quests.explanation: 'Comfortable' describes something that feels physically pleasant and relaxing. David falling asleep so fast shows how comfortable the sofa is.
quests.wordInContext: The airline added more legroom, making long flights far more comfortable.

quests.passage: Long after the science lesson ended, one student stayed behind, curious about how volcanoes actually erupt.
quests.question: eager to learn or know more about something
quests.hint: Notice what this student kept doing after the lesson finished.
quests.explanation: 'Curious' describes a strong desire to learn or find out more. Staying behind with questions shows genuine curiosity.
quests.wordInContext: The toddler was curious about everything, opening every cupboard in the kitchen.

quests.passage: Reports that once took the office hours to finish now took only minutes, thanks to the new, efficient filing system.
quests.question: working well without wasting time or effort
quests.hint: Compare how long the task used to take with how long it takes now.
quests.explanation: 'Efficient' describes a way of working that saves time and avoids waste. The huge drop in time needed shows the new system is efficient.
quests.wordInContext: The factory switched to a more efficient assembly line, doubling output without adding staff.

quests.passage: Rather than take the faster highway inland, they chose the scenic route that wound slowly along the coast.
quests.question: having beautiful natural views
quests.hint: Think about why they gave up speed for this route.
quests.explanation: 'Scenic' describes a place or route offering attractive views, usually of nature. Choosing the coastal road over the faster highway suggests it's worth seeing.
quests.wordInContext: The train ride through the mountains was slow but scenic, with valleys visible the entire way.

quests.passage: No matter how her school events went, her older brother stayed supportive, cheering the loudest from the front row.
quests.question: giving help, encouragement, or approval to someone
quests.hint: Notice how the brother behaves at every event, win or lose.
quests.explanation: 'Supportive' describes someone who encourages and stands by another person. Cheering loudest, every time, shows constant encouragement.
quests.wordInContext: Her coworkers were supportive during her first difficult week on the job.

quests.passage: Marked down to half its original price, the winter coat felt like a real bargain, too good to leave on the rack.
quests.question: something sold at a lower price than expected or usual
quests.hint: Think about how the coat's current price compares to its usual price.
quests.explanation: 'Bargain' describes an item priced lower than its normal value, making it a good deal. Half-price is a clear example of a bargain.
quests.wordInContext: Finding a laptop that cheap felt like a bargain, so she bought it before anyone else could.

quests.passage: To help students concentrate better, the cafeteria began serving more nutritious meals, swapping fried snacks for fresh fruit and whole grain bread.
quests.question: providing the substances the body needs to stay healthy
quests.hint: Notice what kind of food replaced the old menu items.
quests.explanation: 'Nutritious' describes food that is good for the body's health, unlike food that is just tasty or convenient. Fresh fruit and whole grains are classic examples.
quests.wordInContext: Doctors recommend a nutritious breakfast before a long day of exams.

quests.passage: Small enough to slide into a jacket pocket, the new speaker was fully portable and went wherever she did.
quests.question: able to be carried or moved easily
quests.hint: Think about the size of the speaker and where it can fit.
quests.explanation: 'Portable' describes something light and small enough to carry around easily. Fitting inside a pocket is a strong sign of portability.
quests.wordInContext: The company released a portable printer that fits inside a backpack.

quests.passage: After a full night's sleep, the children woke up energetic, racing each other to the park before breakfast was even ready.
quests.question: full of energy and enthusiasm
quests.hint: Notice what the children do the moment they wake up.
quests.explanation: 'Energetic' describes having a lot of energy and eagerness to move or act. Racing to the park right away shows their high energy.
quests.wordInContext: The new puppy was so energetic that it wore out everyone at the park within an hour.

quests.passage: The sitcom's final scene turned out hilarious, and by dinner the family was still repeating the punchline to each other.
quests.question: extremely funny
quests.hint: Think about why the family kept mentioning this scene later.
quests.explanation: 'Hilarious' means extremely funny, funnier than something that just makes you smile. Still laughing about it hours later shows real comedy.
quests.wordInContext: His impression of the manager was so hilarious that even the manager laughed.

quests.passage: After years crammed into a small studio downtown, their new apartment felt spacious, with room to spare in every corner.
quests.question: having a lot of open space; roomy
quests.hint: Compare the new apartment to where they used to live.
quests.explanation: 'Spacious' describes a place with plenty of room. The contrast with their cramped old studio makes the extra space stand out.
quests.wordInContext: The new office has a spacious lobby with room for large events.

quests.passage: The teacher praised him for being punctual — he had arrived five minutes early to every single class that semester.
quests.question: arriving or doing something at the arranged or expected time
quests.hint: Notice the pattern in how early he always arrives.
quests.explanation: 'Punctual' describes someone who is never late, often arriving right on time or early. Arriving early to every class all semester shows strong punctuality.
quests.wordInContext: Being punctual matters at this company; the meeting starts the moment the clock hits nine.

quests.passage: The event ran smoothly from start to finish because the volunteers were so organized, with every task assigned days in advance.
quests.question: arranged in a careful, orderly way
quests.hint: Think about why the event went so smoothly.
quests.explanation: 'Organized' describes planning things in a clear, orderly way ahead of time. Assigning tasks in advance is what kept the event running well.
quests.wordInContext: Her notes were so organized that classmates borrowed them before every exam.

quests.passage: None of the tourists recognized the exotic fruits piled on the market stall, each one shaped and colored like nothing they'd seen back home.
quests.question: unusual or interesting because it comes from a distant, unfamiliar place
quests.hint: Notice why the tourists can't identify these fruits.
quests.explanation: 'Exotic' describes something unfamiliar because it comes from a faraway or different place. The tourists' confusion shows these fruits aren't found where they're from.
quests.wordInContext: The restaurant's menu featured exotic spices imported from three different continents.

quests.passage: Their grandmother was affectionate with everyone, wrapping each grandchild in a hug the second they walked through the door.
quests.question: showing warm, caring feelings openly
quests.hint: Think about what grandmother does the instant she sees her grandchildren.
quests.explanation: 'Affectionate' describes openly showing love or warmth toward someone. Hugging every grandchild right away is a clear sign of affection.
quests.wordInContext: He wasn't usually affectionate in public, but he hugged his son tightly at the airport.

quests.passage: Thanks to a store discount on winter boots, Emma walked out having saved twenty dollars on her purchase.
quests.question: an amount taken off the usual price
quests.hint: Notice what happened to the price Emma actually paid.
quests.explanation: 'Discount' means a reduction in price. Emma saving twenty dollars is the direct result of this price cut.
quests.wordInContext: Students get a discount on museum tickets if they show a valid ID.

quests.passage: Hours of slow cooking with fresh herbs left the stew rich and flavorful, worth every minute of waiting.
quests.question: having a strong, pleasant taste
quests.hint: Think about what the long cooking time and herbs did to the stew.
quests.explanation: 'Flavorful' describes food with a rich, noticeable taste. The slow cooking and fresh herbs are exactly what built up that strong flavor.
quests.wordInContext: The chef added extra garlic to make the sauce more flavorful.

quests.passage: She switched to wireless headphones so she could exercise without any cords swinging around or getting caught on her arm.
quests.question: operating without a connecting wire or cable
quests.hint: Notice what problem she's trying to avoid while exercising.
quests.explanation: 'Wireless' describes a device that works without cables. Not having cords to worry about while moving is the main advantage here.
quests.wordInContext: Most new laptops now connect to printers wirelessly instead of through a cable.

quests.passage: After the long hike, the warm bath had a soothing effect on her sore muscles, easing the ache within minutes.
quests.question: having a calming or comforting effect, reducing pain or stress
quests.hint: Think about what the bath did to her sore muscles.
quests.explanation: 'Soothing' describes something that calms or relieves discomfort. The warm water reducing her muscle pain shows this calming effect.
quests.wordInContext: The nurse spoke in a soothing voice to calm the frightened child before the injection.

quests.passage: The storyteller's captivating voice held every child in the room silent, eyes fixed on her, waiting for what came next.
quests.question: extremely interesting, holding someone's full attention
quests.hint: Notice how the children in the room are reacting.
quests.explanation: 'Captivating' describes something so interesting that it fully holds a person's attention. A room of silent, fixed-eyed children shows total captivation.
quests.wordInContext: The documentary's captivating footage of deep-sea creatures kept viewers glued to the screen.
